statement: Trapping got a major overhaul; you only need to run traps on one character and the XP and efficiency apply to other characters.
Use your Beastmaster for straight efficiency to maximize critters.
Use Maestro's transfusion talent to get massive XP for trapping skill; it affects all characters' traps if placed on the Maestro.
Ruby card sets are now active in the game giving bigger card set bonuses.
Farm bosses and nightmares and easy resource card sets to benefit from the new card sets.
Luck stat was buffed to have more potency on class XP so leveling is easier for new players.
A new sign shows where the first boss is located.
Leveling up now rewards full HP.
Past wave 130 on TD you can now still earn points; expect higher wave clears.
Go to World 4 town on your Maestro and hop on the kitchen table and run all the way right to find the Nebulite.
Maestro must be level 150 to talk to Nebulite.
First quest requires 1 million kills on death note with every mob in worlds 1 to 3.
The death note kills requirement is account-wide not specific to the Maestro; check death note pages to see if completed.
Second task is to kill Chaotic Cheese Orb on your Maestro with no gimmicks.
Final unlock requirement is 12 million green mushroom spore kills on the Maestro specifically then switch Maestro to Voidwalker.
On becoming Voidwalker you get a different type of talent point called a void point.
Void Trail Rerun is the main source of void talent points and can be used once a day to start a void speedrun.
Before the speedrun put points into the Maestro-tab talent Checkmate which awards void talent points and increases the speedrun timer.
If you reset talents or swap presets you must put one point back into Void Trail to get void points back.
Activating the talent transports you to the void world starting at World 1 green mushrooms; kill mobs and open portals.
Each new portal opened awards 30 void talent points.
Be fast because time is limited; the farther you go the more void talent points you get.
Speedrun to the boss and kill the nightmare variant which counts for all three boss variants and three portals.
Bossing Vein makes mobs respawn faster for every unique boss killed during the speedrun.
You can speedrun all the way up to World 5.
Void Radius is an AOE that wipes the screen at high level and gives lots of multikill per tier for 20 seconds after use.
Quad Jab is a great single target talent giving the fourth punch.
Power Orb gives more damage for every 50 class levels above level 200.
Eternal strength
confidence: wisdom and luck increase tab 1 talents' max level and give extra base stats; XP cultivation gives class XP.

statement: Master of the System gives more multikill per tier based on your highest speedrun.
Enchantment Eclipse changes talents of your other characters.
Whopping Whales via Eclipse makes active Beastmaster useful with a chance to reduce incubator time by 3 seconds.
Pirate Flag via Eclipse makes plunderous mobs spawn more frequently.
Voodoo Statification increases potency of all statues on all characters up to over 100 percent bonus.
Epoch increases souls and critter gains based on combined worship and trapping level; roughly six times critters and souls.
Epoch lets him expect level 13 vials.
Blood Marrow increases cooking speed based on total level of meals owned; millions of percent.
At 245 Blood Marrow he gets an extra 15.6 million percent cooking speed.
